headline.process: Within NAAMP, rainfall-associated acoustic change is dominated by recruitment across activity thresholds, not merely stronger calling among cells already active in both surveys.
headline.strength: Most of the rainfall-associated new-activation slope is direct entry at CallingIndex 2-3, so the pattern is not confined to marginal CallingIndex-1 detections.
headline.geometry: Within the full NAAMP sample, the excess allocation is disproportionately taxonomic (route-new species) rather than spatial (new stops).
headline.physical_design: Both boundary geometry and CallingIndex threshold recruitment persist after restricting to pairs with identical physical SiteID at all ten StopNumbers.
headline.simple_social_cue: Not supported: route-new recruitment is not disproportionately allocated to stops that already contained calling species in the dry survey relative to either null.
headline.deeper_cause: Still unresolved at the mediator level. Stable physical-stop response is unsupported; measured mapped wetland context is the next active test.
headline.universality: Not established. Internal disjoint-route directions are concordant but miss the strict two-fold gate, and current Neotropical AnuraSet tests do not satisfy the prefixed threshold-dominance replication rule.

new_activation_strength.ecological_read: Rainfall-associated recruitment is not just weak calls becoming detectable: most of the activation slope is new cells immediately scored as overlapping/full-chorus CallingIndex 2-3.

physical_stop_identity.read: Boundary recruitment does not depend on relocation or renumbering of listening stops.

route_new_context.read: Route-new recruitment is neither preferentially targeted to already-chorusing stops nor preferentially targeted to previously inactive stops beyond the null expectation.

full_sample_crossfit_species.conclusion: Transferable species-specific rainfall response alone is insufficient in the full sample.

temporal_subset.conclusion: The reduced temporal subset cannot identify a stable physical-site mechanism; generic heterogeneity and lower discrimination suffice.

disjoint_routes.interpretation: Both folds have the same broad direction, but each narrowly misses a different pre-fixed criterion.

frogid_australia.authorized: cross-dataset consistency for active-unit taxonomic depth

anuraset_brazil.boundary: AnuraSet weak labels are a stratified machine-learning annotation sample, not continuous effort.

weakened: Simple chorus/social-cue attraction as the sole allocation mechanism
still_plausible_but_unidentified: Context-dependent combinations of species biology and local environment
mediator_status.active_test: Official National Wetlands Inventory hydroperiod linkage to physical NAAMP SiteID coordinates, using a pre-fixed 200 m primary radius and conservative exclusion of ambiguous polygon ties.

interpretation_boundary: Acoustic activity is not abundance, occupancy, colonization or reproductive success.
CallingIndex is ordinal acoustic intensity, not individual calling effort.
No unique physiological mediator has been identified.
No worldwide or continent-general boundary-recruitment law has been established.
RC11 remains frozen and is not altered by these exploratory analyses.
